    46	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    47	
    48	/-- A compatible quasi-coherent module structure on the sections of a cocycle-glued
    49	line bundle over an affine open, together with its finite projective rank-one properties.
    50	
    51	The module instance is written explicitly in the fields so that it is definitionally the
    52	one induced by `qcoh`; a consumer may install `M.qcoh` and recover `M.finite` and
    53	`M.projective` without any proof-irrelevance transport. -/
    54	structure AffineSectionsModel (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    55	    (V : (relCurve C B).Opens) where
    56	  qcoh : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf V
    57	  finite : @Module.Finite Γ(relCurve C B, V) (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V))
    58	    _ _ (@Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE B _ (relCurve C B) V D.sheaf qcoh V (le_refl V))
    59	  projective : @Module.Projective Γ(relCurve C B, V) _
    60	    (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V)) _
    61	    (@Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE B _ (relCurve C B) V D.sheaf qcoh V (le_refl V))
    62	  invertible : @Module.Invertible Γ(relCurve C B, V) (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V))
    63	    _ _ (@Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE B _ (relCurve C B) V D.sheaf qcoh V (le_refl V))
    64	
    65	/-- Sections of a cocycle-glued line bundle on every affine open admit a compatible
    66	invertible module model.  The proof chooses a finite basic-open refinement of the canonical
    67	pointed cover, trivializes after the resulting faithfully flat product localization, and
    68	descends invertibility; finiteness and projectivity are recorded on the same action. -/
    69	theorem nonempty_affineSectionsModel (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    70	    (V : (relCurve C B).Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    71	    Nonempty (D.AffineSectionsModel V) := by
    72	  classical
    73	  obtain ⟨ι, fint, f, anchor, coeff, hP, hpart⟩ :=
    74	    hV.exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement D.pointedCover
    75	  letI : Fintype ι := fint
    76	  let sigma : ι → D.index := fun i => D.pieceIndex (anchor i)
    77	  have hP' : ∀ i : ι, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i) ≤ D.pieces (sigma i) := hP
    78	  have hcov : V ≤ ⨆ i : ι, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i) :=
    79	    le_iSup_basicOpen_of_sum_eq_one coeff f hpart
    80	  let q : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf V :=
    81	    gluedQcohOn B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle hP' hcov
    82	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf V := q
    83	  let m : Module Γ(relCurve C B, V) (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V)) :=
    84	    Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := D.sheaf) (le_refl V)
    85	  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ :=
    86	    Ideal.span_range_eq_top_of_sum_eq_one coeff f hpart
    87	  have hfin : @Module.Finite Γ(relCurve C B, V) (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V)) _ _ m :=
    88	    moduleFinite_glued B D.pieces D.unit hV D.isGluingCocycle
    89	      (fun _ _ _ => rfl) hP' hspan
    90	  have hproj : @Module.Projective Γ(relCurve C B, V) _
    91	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V)) _ m :=
    92	    projective_glued B D.pieces D.unit hV D.isGluingCocycle
    93	      (fun _ _ _ => rfl) hP' hspan
    94	  letI pieceBaseModule : ∀ i : ι, Module Γ(relCurve C B, V)
    95	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op ((relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)))) := fun i =>
    96	    Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := D.sheaf) ((relCurve C B).basicOpen_le (f i))
    97	  letI pieceModule : ∀ i : ι,
    98	      Module Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i))
    99	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op ((relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)))) := fun i =>
   100	    gluedPieceModule B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle hP' i
   101	  letI pieceTower : ∀ i : ι, IsScalarTower Γ(relCurve C B, V)
   102	      Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i))
   103	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op ((relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)))) := fun i =>
   104	    isScalarTower_chart_piece B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle
   105	      (fun _ _ _ => rfl) hP' i
   106	  letI pieceLocalization : ∀ i : ι, IsLocalization.Away (f i)
   107	      Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)) := fun i =>
   108	    hV.isLocalization_basicOpen (f i)
   109	  haveI pieceLocalized : ∀ i : ι, IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers (f i))
   110	      (Scheme.QcohOn.secResₗ (F := D.sheaf)
   111	        ((relCurve C B).basicOpen_le (f i)) (le_refl V)) := fun i =>
   112	    isLocalizedModule_secResₗ_glued B D.pieces D.unit hV D.isGluingCocycle
   113	      (fun _ _ _ => rfl) hP' i
   114	  let e (i : ι) :
   115	      Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)) ⊗[Γ(relCurve C B, V)]
   116	          (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V))
   117	        ≃ₗ[Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i))]
   118	          Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)) :=
   119	    (IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange (Submonoid.powers (f i))
   120	      Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i))
   121	      (Scheme.QcohOn.secResₗ (F := D.sheaf)
   122	        ((relCurve C B).basicOpen_le (f i)) (le_refl V))).equiv.trans
   123	      (gluedPieceEquiv B D.pieces D.unit D.isGluingCocycle hP' i)
   124	  letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat Γ(relCurve C B, V)
   125	      (∀ i : ι, Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i))) :=
   126	    Module.FaithfullyFlat.pi_of_span_eq_top f hspan
   127	  let E := Module.piTrivialization e
   128	  letI : Module.Invertible
   129	      (∀ i : ι, Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)))
   130	      ((∀ i : ι, Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i))) ⊗[Γ(relCurve C B, V)]
   131	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V))) :=
   132	    Module.Invertible.congr E.symm
   133	  have hinv : @Module.Invertible Γ(relCurve C B, V) (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V)) _ _ m :=
   134	    Module.Invertible.of_invertible_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat
   135	      Γ(relCurve C B, V)
   136	      (∀ i : ι, Γ(relCurve C B, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f i)))
   137	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op V))
   138	  exact ⟨⟨q, hfin, hproj, hinv⟩⟩
   139	
   140	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   141	
   142	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	/-!
    12	# Intrinsic theta descent on a widened divisor cover
    13	
    14	For an arbitrary affine piece `U_j`, the restriction of `O(a Theta)` to the divisor is
    15	the genuine module
    16	
    17	`Gamma(U_j, O(a Theta)) / (f_j) Gamma(U_j, O(a Theta))`.
    18	
    19	Unlike the older chart-typed theta module, this quotient does not choose a trivialization
    20	of the line bundle on `U_j`.  Restriction to `U_i inter U_j` sends the equation-generated
    21	submodule into the symmetric overlap ideal, so the piece quotients have two canonical
    22	overlap maps.  Their equalizer is the intrinsic theta restriction on the widened divisor.
    23	
    24	The construction below supplies the module that the widened equalizer algebra acts on.
    25	It is the chart-free input for proving invertibility and identifying the result with the
    26	cover-independent high-window quotient.
    27	-/
    28	
    29	set_option autoImplicit false
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	
    39	section GluedQsmul
    40	
    41	variable (B : Type u) [CommRing B] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of B))]
    42	variable {J : Type u} (U : J -> X.Opens) (g : forall i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ)
    43	
    44	/-- Componentwise multiplication is independent of whether a scalar is first restricted
    45	to an intermediate open. -/
    46	theorem gluedQsmul_res {V W Z : X.Opens} (hWV : W ≤ V) (hVZ : V ≤ Z)
    47	    (r : Γ(X, Z)) (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B U g W)) :
    48	    gluedQsmul B U g hWV (X.resHom hVZ r) s =
    49	      gluedQsmul B U g (hWV.trans hVZ) r s := by
    50	  apply Subtype.ext
    51	  funext j
    52	  rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    53	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
    54	
    55	end GluedQsmul
    56	
    57	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    58	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    59	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsProper C.hom]
    60	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    61	
    62	namespace AffAdaptation
    63	
    64	/-- Intrinsic theta sections on the affine overlap of two widened pieces. -/
    65	noncomputable abbrev ThetaOverlapSections (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    66	    (i j : D.index) : Type u :=
    67	  (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
    68	
    69	/-- A finite projective invertible sections model on a piece overlap.  Properness of the
    70	curve makes the intersection of the two affine pieces affine. -/
    71	noncomputable def thetaOverlapSectionsModel (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    72	    (i j : D.index) :
    73	    (thetaChartDatum C R π a).AffineSectionsModel (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
    74	  Classical.choice ((thetaChartDatum C R π a).nonempty_affineSectionsModel
    75	    (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) (D.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper i j))
    76	
    77	/-- The overlap-ring action on intrinsic theta sections. -/
    78	@[reducible]
    79	noncomputable def thetaOverlapSectionsModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    80	    (i j : D.index) :
    81	    Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    82	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
    83	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
    84	    (A.thetaOverlapSectionsModel (π := π) a i j).qcoh
    85	  Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf)
    86	    (le_refl (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
    87	
    88	attribute [local instance] thetaPieceSectionsModule thetaOverlapSectionsModule
    89	
    90	/-- The equation-generated submodule of theta sections on one piece. -/
    91	noncomputable def thetaPieceVanishing (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    92	    (j : D.index) :
    93	    letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
    94	      (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    95	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
    96	    Submodule Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
    97	      (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    98	  Ideal.span {A.eqn j} • ⊤
    99	
   100	/-- The symmetric overlap ideal acting on intrinsic theta sections. -/
   101	noncomputable def thetaOverlapVanishing (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   102	    (i j : D.index) :
   103	    letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   104	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   105	    A.thetaOverlapSectionsModule (π := π) a i j
   106	    Submodule Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   107	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   108	  A.ovlIdeal i j • ⊤
   109	
   110	/-- Intrinsic theta sections restricted to the divisor on one widened piece. -/
   111	noncomputable abbrev ThetaPieceQuotient (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   112	    (j : D.index) : Type u :=
   113	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
   114	      (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
   115	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   116	  A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j ⧸ A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a j
   117	
   118	/-- Intrinsic theta sections modulo both equations on a piece overlap. -/
   119	noncomputable abbrev ThetaOverlapQuotient (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   120	    (i j : D.index) : Type u :=
   121	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   122	      (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   123	    A.thetaOverlapSectionsModule (π := π) a i j
   124	  A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j ⧸
   125	    A.thetaOverlapVanishing (π := π) a i j
   126	
   127	/-- The tensor restriction from the previous module is canonically the intrinsic quotient
   128	by the local equation. -/
   129	noncomputable def thetaPieceRestrictionEquiv (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   130	    (j : D.index) :
   131	    letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
   132	        (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
   133	      A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   134	    A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j ≃ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)]
   135	      A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a j :=
   136	  TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul
   137	    (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) (Ideal.span {A.eqn j})
   138	
   139	/-- Restriction of intrinsic theta sections from the left piece to an overlap. -/
   140	noncomputable def thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   141	    (i j : D.index) :
   142	    letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)
   143	        (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a i) :=
   144	      A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a i
   145	    letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   146	        (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   147	      A.thetaOverlapSectionsModule (π := π) a i j
   148	    A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a i →ₛₗ[
   149	      (relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i)).toRingHom]
   150	      A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j := by
   151	  sorry
   152	
   153	/-- Restriction of intrinsic theta sections from the right piece to an overlap. -/
   154	noncomputable def thetaSectionsToOverlapRight (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   155	    (i j : D.index) :
   156	    letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
   157	        (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
   158	      A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   159	    letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   160	        (A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j) :=
   161	      A.thetaOverlapSectionsModule (π := π) a i j
   162	    A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j →ₛₗ[
   163	      (relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j)).toRingHom]
   164	      A.ThetaOverlapSections (π := π) a i j := by
   165	  sorry
   166	
   167	/-- The left restriction sends equation multiples into the symmetric overlap ideal. -/
   168	theorem thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft_vanishing_le (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   169	    (i j : D.index) :
   170	    A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a i ≤
   171	      Submodule.comap (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j)
   172	        (A.thetaOverlapVanishing (π := π) a i j) := by
   173	  sorry
   174	
   175	/-- The right restriction sends equation multiples into the symmetric overlap ideal. -/
   176	theorem thetaSectionsToOverlapRight_vanishing_le (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   177	    (i j : D.index) :
   178	    A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a j ≤
   179	      Submodule.comap (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j)
   180	        (A.thetaOverlapVanishing (π := π) a i j) := by
   181	  sorry
   182	
   183	/-- The induced left overlap map on divisor-restricted theta sections. -/
   184	noncomputable def thetaToOverlapLeft (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   185	    (i j : D.index) :
   186	    A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i →ₛₗ[
   187	      (relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces i)).toRingHom]
   188	      A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j :=
   189	  Submodule.mapQ (A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a i)
   190	    (A.thetaOverlapVanishing (π := π) a i j)
   191	    (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft (π := π) a i j)
   192	    (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapLeft_vanishing_le (π := π) a i j)
   193	
   194	/-- The induced right overlap map on divisor-restricted theta sections. -/
   195	noncomputable def thetaToOverlapRight (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
   196	    (i j : D.index) :
   197	    A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a j →ₛₗ[
   198	      (relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_right : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ D.pieces j)).toRingHom]
   199	      A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j :=
   200	  Submodule.mapQ (A.thetaPieceVanishing (π := π) a j)
   201	    (A.thetaOverlapVanishing (π := π) a i j)
   202	    (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j)
   203	    (A.thetaSectionsToOverlapRight_vanishing_le (π := π) a i j)
   204	
   205	end AffAdaptation
   206	
   207	end AlgebraicGeometry
